physician.physician:draw: A little blood, for the tests.

gqueen.gqueen:reflect: So many of you. One fairest.
gqueen.gqueen:ring: Look at me. All of me.

familiar: Good help is hard to find.
golem: Wind him up, let him go.

boss: And that is the last word.

warrior: I must purge the evil of this place.
mage: Someone has been meddling down here.
warlock: It can smell them. So can I.
Quiet. It wants to come out.
brawler: Come on then. All of you.

eyrie.warrior: So that is what they did to the town.
eyrie.ranger: The whole town, caught under their dome.
eyrie.mage: Siege magic. That dome is drinking the town dry.
eyrie.warlock: Their dome. I can taste its magic from here.
eyrie.tinkerer: That is no storm. That is a machine made of spells.
eyrie.brawler: They have caged the whole town.

mystic: The stars said you would come.
